en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 18.Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā narrated from Ibrāhīm ibn ʿUmar, from Abū ʿAbdillāh (a) who said, “

Whoever says three times, ‘Glory be to my Lord, the Great, and praise be to Him. I seek forgiveness from my Lord and turn penitently to Him,’ the Throne [of Allah] makes a sound like the sound of chains striking a bowl.”
